CCAS.Settings.Pack.Name: Cursor pack
CCAS.Settings.Pack.Hint: A bundled cursor pack, or Custom to use the image paths below.
CCAS.Settings.MaxSize.Name: Maximum cursor size (px)
CCAS.Settings.MaxSize.Hint: Images larger than this are automatically downscaled. On Chromium (browser and the Foundry app) the effective ceiling is 32 px: larger cursors are hidden near window edges (anti-spoofing) and above 128 physical px they are never rendered.
CCAS.Settings.default.Name: Default cursor image
CCAS.Settings.default.Hint: The normal arrow cursor. Leave empty for the Foundry default.
CCAS.Settings.pointer.Name: Pointer cursor image
CCAS.Settings.pointer.Hint: Shown over clickable elements. Leave empty for the Foundry default.
CCAS.Settings.grab.Name: Grab cursor image
CCAS.Settings.grab.Hint: Shown when dragging the canvas. Leave empty for the Foundry default.
CCAS.Menu.Hotspots.Name: Cursor hotspots
CCAS.Menu.Hotspots.Label: Open hotspot editor
CCAS.Menu.Hotspots.Hint: Visually place the click point of each cursor directly on its image.
CCAS.Editor.Title: Cursor Hotspot Editor
CCAS.Editor.Hint: Click a cursor image to place its active point (the pixel that actually clicks). Test the result in the strip below each image, then save.
CCAS.Keybind.Debug.Name: Toggle cursor debug badge
CCAS.Keybind.Debug.Hint: Shows a badge following the mouse that reports which cursor the hovered element uses.
CCAS.Settings.grabDown.Name: Grabbing (held) cursor image
CCAS.Settings.grabDown.Hint: Shown while actually holding/dragging (e.g. a grabbed die). Leave empty to reuse the grab image.
